# FleetPulse-AI — Commercial Fleet Telematics & Autonomous Safety Platform

> **System Overview:** AI-driven telematics and autonomous fleet safety platform designed for Apex Freight Logistics. Replaces $165,000/yr Fleet Supervisor headcount overhead with 0ms real-time vehicle tracking, Samsara/Geotab 2026 AI coaching, and FMCSA DOT digital inspection logs.

## 🚀 Key Features & Endpoints
- **Real-Time Telematics Grid:** Live 450-vehicle tracking, speed, fuel, and driver fatigue monitoring.
- **Digital Pre-Trip DVIR Checklist:** 100% electronic inspection report with photo verification.
- **Level 1–3 Slide-Over Drawers:** Zero-context-switching in-depth vehicle DTC fault code inspection.
- **4-Tier Commercial Licensing:** Enterprise Self-Hosted, White-Label Agency ($1,499), Source Code Buyout ($6,999), Cloud SaaS ($249/mo).
